name: Whiskey (Bourbon)
description: American whiskey distilled from a mash of at least 51% corn and aged in new charred oak, which gives it caramel, vanilla and baking-spice sweetness. It goes into the barrel at no more than 62.5% ABV and is bottled at 40% or higher. The default pour for an Old Fashioned, Mint Julep or Whiskey Sour.
